newsitem.title: USA: Starwood acquires hotel co for $327 mln.
newsitem.headline: Starwood acquires hotel co for $327 mln.

text.p: Starwood Lodging Corp said Friday it has reached a definitive agreement to acquire HEI Hotels LLC for $327 million.
The company said the deal would be accretive to its earnings in the first year of operations.
The deal, which is expected to close by the end of January, was carried out by Starwood Lodging Corp and Starwood Lodging Trust.

The purchase price is comprised of Starwood Lodging paired shares and limited partnership interests in Starwood Lodging partnerships exchangeable for paired shares of the trust and corporation, as well as $112 million in cash and debt assumption, it said.

HEI, which is based in Westport, Conn., manages 18 hotels, as well as 10 hotel properties it owns in a joint venture with PRISA II, an institutional real estate investment fund managed by Prudential Real Estate Investors.
Starwood said HEI will be operated as a wholly owned subsidiary. HEI Chief Executive and President Gary Mendell is expected to become president of the trust, the company said.
